info.name: UiPath Automation Hub Alerts Schedules API

params.name: $filter
params.description: OData filter expression to narrow results (e.g., State eq 'Running')

params.name: $top
params.description: Maximum number of records to return (default 100, max 1000)

params.name: $skip
params.description: Number of records to skip for pagination

items.docs: Retrieves a list of time-based triggers configured for automation processes. Each schedule defines when and how often a process should run, along with the target robots and input arguments.
